rule: Every published figure, tool response and benchmark ground truth cites exactly one universe_id. A figure without a universe_id is not citable. Two figures for the same metric are only 'in conflict' if they cite the same universe_id.

U-FHA-2025-DECISIONED.description: All FHA applications reaching a credit decision, 2025

U-TOP100-VOLUME-2025.description: The 100 FHA lenders with the most decisioned applications in U-FHA-2025-DECISIONED
U-TOP100-VOLUME-2025.count_rule: lenders with a published api/lender file and in_top_100_by_volume=true (98 files exist; two of the 100 have no lender file)
U-TOP100-VOLUME-2025.status: canonical; membership list to be published as one file

U-TOP100-WITH-REASONS-2025.description: Members of U-TOP100-VOLUME-2025 that report at least one HMDA denial reason
U-TOP100-WITH-REASONS-2025.status: canonical for reason-share medians served by get_denial_reason_shares

U-PEER-MEDIANS-2025.description: The peer set used for peer_medians in api/index.json (DTI 40.3, incomplete 1.8, ...)
U-PEER-MEDIANS-2025.filters: NOT WRITTEN DOWN: produced by the offline HMDA pipeline; the set and the share definition are not recoverable from any file in this repository
U-PEER-MEDIANS-2025.status: UNDEFINED — figures citing it are marked provisional until the pipeline publishes the definition

U-REASON-FILE-2025.filters: the file says '~94 largest' but records n_lenders=70; definition inconsistent with itself
U-REASON-FILE-2025.status: UNDEFINED — to be regenerated from U-TOP100-WITH-REASONS-2025 or retired

U-STATES-SMALLBIG-2025.description: States and territories with published small-loan (<$150K) and big-loan (>$250K) FHA denial rates
U-STATES-SMALLBIG-2025.status: canonical for small-loan penalty figures; PR is a member (penalty 1.19x), which is why the floor is 1.19x and not 'about 1.3x'

citations.benchmark.json q6: U-STATES-SMALLBIG-2025 — ground truth floor 'about 1.3x' does not reproduce; floor is 1.19x (PR)
citations.benchmark.json q8: U-PEER-MEDIANS-2025 (provisional) — 1.8% is the peer_medians value; the U-TOP100-WITH-REASONS-2025 median is 2.8%
citations.benchmark.json q9: U-FHA-2025-DECISIONED restricted to metro; metro lender threshold >=100 decisioned
citations.how-often-are-fha-loans-denied.html reas: U-PEER-MEDIANS-2025 (provisional) — page text says 'across the 100 largest'; that label is wrong and is corrected in this commit
citations.claims/*.json (189): U-FHA-2025-DECISIONED unless the passport's claim.subject narrows it
